assignment: Direct AuditMap owner request continuing the nationwide enrichment campaign; no separate OpenTask assignment or GitHub issue URL was supplied.
reviewMethod: Recent official-source indexing review, live source-availability checks, Openverse reusable-license search, exact source-page rights review, and visual destination-match review. Search-engine results, proprietary listings, wildlife close-ups, unrelated parks, and event portraits were not accepted as representative parent coverage.
sourceAvailabilityCheck: On 2026-08-11, the Broward County pages and PDFs listed below returned HTTP 404 both to direct GET requests and when opened through a separate web fetcher, although official search indexes had crawled and exposed their contents within the prior two weeks. They are retained as provenance for this research audit but are not treated as currently reachable publication sources. The Flickr rights pages returned HTTP 200.

launch-fl-hollywood-t-y-park.name: T.Y. Park
launch-fl-hollywood-t-y-park.photoFinding: All ten reusable results are near-duplicate photographs from one March 2007 event. Visual review shows people, balloons, decorated picnic tables, and a shelter edge rather than representative visitor views of the park or its major amenities.
launch-fl-hollywood-t-y-park.minimumEvidenceNeeded: Four varied reusable views collectively showing the lake or fitness loop, Castaway Island or another major facility, a playground or campground context, and ordinary park circulation or picnic landscape.
freshnessRisks: official Broward County source URLs returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-11

launch-fl-hollywood-t-y-park.subsiteDecision: No subsite is eligible while the parent remains unpublished and no candidate has both an exact reviewed position and a matching reusable destination photograph.
